title: test(scripts): derive the zero-test workspace members and pin the exclusion so it can expire (objectui#9106)
body:
Fixes #9106

Triage ruled the direction (option A plus a named exclusion): no `test` script and no `--passWithNoTests` for the three test-less members, because that entry would exit 0 while the root-config comparison exits 1 — manufacturing divergence between exactly the two invocations objectui#8991's acceptance requires to agree. This PR is the **carrier**, not the decision.

## The problem the carrier solves

objectui#8991 derived the population, fixed the half that had test files (objectui#9105) and stopped on the half that has none — and landed nothing that records either the derivation or the stop. Re-measured on `1e0e46af9`:

```
git grep -ln "8991" origin/main -- scripts packages apps examples
  examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-vector/high-dimensional-vector.json
  packages/plugin-gantt/docs/verification/23-i18n-chinese.png
```

Two incidental files, a vector fixture and a screenshot. So the next derivation of this population re-discovers the three and re-asks the same question — which is literally what produced objectui#9106.

Prose would not have held. `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`'s own docstring asserted a repo-wide property that eleven files violated (objectui#5406), in this directory and about this subject; the remedy was to make `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` walk the repo instead. This PR is that shape.

## What lands

One new file: `scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts` (17 tests). It walks every workspace member (globs read from `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, not hard-coded), partitions each by {has a `test` script} against {has test files}, and asserts the zero-and-zero bucket **equals** the named list.

Equality, not subset, is the whole point — the exclusion has to be able to expire:

| direction | what goes red |
|:--|:--|
| a new unadjudicated zero-test member appears | the equality assertion, naming the extra member |
| a listed member gains a test file | the equality assertion **and** that member's own case |
| a listed member gains a `test` script | the equality assertion **and** that member's own case |

The sibling pin `scripts/__tests__/runner-package-test-entry-3746.test.ts` records `BARE_ENTRY_BASELINE` as a deliberate ceiling — "may shrink and must not grow" — and is therefore green forever once a listed package leaves the population. Right for a ceiling being worked down; wrong for an exclusion that is supposed to end. Hence the different assertion here, and the comment saying why.

Two premises the exclusion rests on are pinned beside it, so the recorded reason cannot go stale silently:

- the root config still derives `passWithNoTests` from the CLI (the reason a positional collecting nothing exits **1** rather than 0);
- `apps/site` is reached by no vitest project at all.

## Re-measured, with a control of known direction

All four from the repo root at `1e0e46af9`, in one sitting:

| invocation | exit | output |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run apps/site/` | **1** | `No test files found, exiting with code 1` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run examples/hello-world/` | **1** | same |
| `pnpm exec vitest run examples/byo-backend-console/` | **1** | same |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/layout/` (control) | **0** | 21 files, 217 tests |

Three 1s with no 0 beside them would be a broken harness rather than a measurement.

## Correction: the card's `apps/site` mechanism is right in its conclusion and wrong in its reason

The card says an app "comes back through the root config's `projects` array as its own project rooted at the app directory, so a positional filter naming `apps/site/` is matched against paths relative to that project and can never contain it". That is objectui#8240's mechanism for `apps/console`, transplanted. It does not apply to `apps/site`, which has no `vitest.config.ts` and appears nowhere in the `projects` array — the only app config pulled in is `./apps/console/vitest.config.ts`.

The real reason is stronger: **no project collects `apps/site` at all.** The root-level projects exclude `apps/**` and their include globs name `packages`/`examples`/`eslint-rules`/`scripts`.

Derived, not cited — with a real test file planted in `apps/site` and the identical file shape planted in `examples/hello-world` as the control:

| probe | exit | result |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `vitest run apps/site/` **with a test file present** | **1** | `No test files found` — no project collects it |
| `vitest run examples/hello-world/` with the same file shape | **0** | 1 file, 1 test — the control fires |
| `vitest run --project @object-ui/site` | **1** | `No projects matched the filter "@object-ui/site"` |

Both mutations were removed and `git diff HEAD` is empty. This also confirms the fence on option D: a `--project` entry for `apps/site` needs a `site` project to exist first.

## Proof the carrier can fail, both directions

Anchor counts printed before and after each mutation; restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`, not by an exit code.

**Leg 1 — a new zero-test member appears.** Synthetic `examples/__ablation-9106-synthetic/package.json`. Anchor: `examples/*` manifests 4 to 5. Result: exit **1**, 1 failed of 17, naming the extra member in the diff of derived against recorded.

**Leg 2 — listed members stop being zero-test.** A test file added to `examples/hello-world` and to `apps/site`. Anchors: test files 0 to 1 in each. Result: exit **1**, **4** failed of 17 — the equality assertion, both per-member cases, and the objectui#8991 bucket assertion.

Restored: exit **0**, 17 passed.

## Gates run locally

| required context | command | exit |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `Test (shard n/4)` | `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` (145 files, 4294 tests) | 0 |
| `Type Check` | `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `Type Check` | `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` | 0 |
| `Lint` | `pnpm exec eslint scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts` (1 file linted, 0 problems) | 0 |
| `Changeset Declaration` | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 |

`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, verbatim:

```
Compared the working tree with 1e0e46af9 (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores, 0 changeset(s) added.
No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.
```

No changeset file is added: nothing publishable moved, and the gate agrees rather than merely tolerating it.

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the single changed path reports NOT GOVERNED, so the ordinary merge-queue route applies.

`Build & E2E` and `Build Docs` are declared to CI: one new test file under `scripts/` builds nothing and ships nothing.

## Not in this PR

- objectui#8991's three landed entries are untouched. `packages/layout`, `packages/test-support` and `examples/console-starter` all still read `vitest run --root ../.. DIR/`.
- objectui#9146, filed from this round: `packages/plugin-ai` and `packages/vscode-extension` carry `--passWithNoTests` in their `test` entry while both DO have test files, so those two entries cannot notice their own collection going empty. Adjacent class, different adjudication, deliberately not changed here — and the new pin stays green with those flags in place.
